surface.$description: Elevation tiers. Tier 0 canvas, tier 1 card, tier 2 floating glass, tier 3 sheet or panel.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:ScreenContainer neutral.98; GlassPanel and glassEffect.ts; SRC-WEB-APP:assets/styles/main.scss body background

card.$description: Flat card, input, toast and sheet background.

glass.$description: Frosted tint over blurred content (iOS value; Android uses glass-android).

glass-android.$description: Android glass tint; the blur method renders lighter so the tint is weaker.

glass-solid.$description: Opaque fallback when blur is unavailable or text needs guaranteed contrast.

glass-bar.$description: Bottom tab bar tint. 0.80 on both platforms keeps ink above 4.5:1 over any cover.

up.note: Production uses 0.60 on iOS and 0.80 on Android; over a black cover the 0.60 tint drops active labels to 4.43:1, so the Android value becomes the rule.

scrim.$description: Backdrop behind sheets and dialogs (neutral.20 at 80 percent).

avatar-fallback.$description: Background of the default person and token glyphs.

cover-fallback.$description: Behind the address gradient when no cover image exists.

text.$description: Text roles. Every role passes 4.5:1 against surface.canvas, surface.card and surface.glass-solid unless its description says otherwise.

muted.$description: Secondary text, the #XXXX suffix, counters, descriptions. 5.72:1 on white, 4.91:1 on glass-solid.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:suffix and secondary labels use neutral[60]; inactive top tabs neutral[45]
up.note: Observed neutral.60 reaches 2.86:1 and neutral.45 drops to 4.08:1 on glass; neutral.40 is the lightest step that passes AA on every light surface.

subtle.$description: Decorative or redundant text only (repeated information, watermarks). 2.86:1 on white: never the sole carrier of information.

up.note: Kept for migration mapping; new work uses text.muted.

placeholder.$description: Input placeholders and character counters. 4.76:1 on white.

up.note: Observed neutral.70 reaches 2.11:1; neutral.45 is the lightest AA-passing step on a white field.

inverse.$description: Text on surface.inverse, primary buttons and dark chips.

link.$description: Links and accent text. 5.72:1 on white, 5.47:1 on the canvas, 4.91:1 on the opaque glass tint; never on translucent glass.

up.note: Production links are ink-coloured; the accent becomes the link colour so it has a functional role.
Observed #1C2A3A is an off-palette literal two units from neutral.20; the palette value replaces it.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:LUKSOTextInput, LUKSOButton secondary, LUKSOCheckbox, LUKSOToast (neutral[90]); focused input neutral[35]

default.$description: Card, input, secondary button and toast borders. Decorative; components using it must also be identifiable by label, fill or shadow.

strong.$description: Boundary that passes 3:1 on white for controls whose border is their only affordance (outlined chips, radio rings).

up.note: neutral.50 on white is 3.94:1; neutral.55 (3.31:1) is the lightest step that still passes 3:1 on white and canvas.

focus.$description: Focused input border and keyboard focus ring. 6.95:1 on white.

error.$description: Error input border. 4.36:1 on white passes the 3:1 component requirement.

glass-reflex.$description: Top and left highlight edge of glass surfaces.

glass-counter.$description: Bottom and right counter edge of glass surfaces.

glass-bar-dark.$description: Hairline dark edge on top of the bottom bar.

accent.$description: The Universal Profiles accent, used sparingly as a frame: links, selected states, primary calls to action in marketing, the brand gradient.

default.$description: Accent text and icons. 5.72:1 on white.

fill.$description: Interactive accent fill that carries accent.on-fill at 5.72:1.

brand.$description: Key brand colour for large type, icons and decorative fills. Equal to the board swatch #6981EC. 3.53:1 on white: not for body text.

soft.$description: Tinted background for selected rows and accent chips.

gradient-start.$description: Brand gradient (top or left); mirrors the app icon top.

gradient-end.$description: Brand gradient (bottom or right); mirrors the app icon bottom.

interactive.$description: Neutral interactive fills used by product buttons and controls.

up.note: Production relies on the native ripple; a defined pressed tint gives web parity.

unselected-on-glass.$description: Inactive bottom-tab icons and labels on the glass bar: 5.26:1 over a black cover at the 0.80 tint.

up.note: Derived from the worst-case composite; see accessibility/contrast-report.md L-37.

unselected.$description: Inactive tab text and icons at full opacity (5.47:1 on canvas).

up.note: Production renders inactive top tabs as neutral.45 at 55 percent opacity and bottom tabs as ink at 50 percent; both composite below 3:1. A solid muted colour keeps the same visual weight and passes AA.

status.$description: Feedback colours. Text roles pass 4.5:1 on light surfaces; fills pass 3:1 against white and carry the listed text colour.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:green[54] checks and toggles; SRC-WEB-COMPONENTS:success button
up.note: Observed green.54 is kept as the icon colour on dark or tinted fills; text and control fills move to darker steps to pass AA.

fill.$description: Success buttons and badges that carry white text (5.52:1).

control.$description: Switch and toggle on-state track: 4.28:1 against white as a non-text indicator.

icon.$description: Observed check colour; decorative or on dark surfaces only.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:LUKSOTextInput error red[55]; LUKSOButton error red[65]
up.note: Observed red.55 text reaches 4.36:1 and red.65 reaches 3.27:1; text moves to red.45.

fill.$description: Destructive button fill; white text at 5.71:1.
Warning and testnet fill; carries text.default at 7.35:1.

icon.$description: Standalone warning glyphs and dots on light surfaces (4.18:1 on white). Warning fills carry text; icons that stand alone use this.

up.note: Production has no info state; defined so alerts have a complete set.

network.$description: Semantic network identity used by network tags and dots. Text next to a network colour is always text.default or text.muted.

up.note: Follows color.network.lukso-testnet: the palette step replaces the hard-coded literal (R-04).

avatar.$description: Avatar ring and badge ring: always the surface colour so the avatar reads as breaking the cover edge.

up.source: SRC-MOBILE-APP:LUKSOProfileIdenticon white ring; SRC-WEB-APP:ProfileCard.vue outline neutral-100

gradient.$description: Named gradient stops. The address gradient itself is computed from the profile address and has no fixed tokens; these are its fallbacks.

address-fallback-start.$description: Cover fallback when no valid address exists (neutral.20 at 6 percent).

address-fallback-end.$description: Cover fallback end stop (neutral.20 at 12 percent).

glass.$description: Glass tint gradients and button states, listed as colour stops. Left-to-right for cards; top-to-bottom for buttons.

toggle-on.$description: Glass toggle track, on. Replaces the platform system green so the state colour belongs to the palette and passes 3:1.

android-overlay.$description: Overlay above the blurred cover copy on Android full-screen glass.
